title: ocimum cyclophyllum
intro: Ocimum cyclophyllum, commonly known as African basil, is a plant species in the mint family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ocimum cyclophyllum include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Ocimum cyclophyllum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and aromatic properties.
